title: Demo data usage
summary: Project-wide guidance for using the synthetic users in this Qry demo.
body_markdown:
# Demo data usage

All people and email addresses in this project are synthetic examples. Use them to demonstrate dbt publishing, endpoint lookup, and response shape only.

Do not treat this three-row dataset as evidence about real users, adoption, behavior, or business performance.

title: Interpreting the demo user records
summary: Defines the identity fields and data-quality limits shared by the seeded and staged user data.
body_markdown:
# Interpreting the demo user records

`user_id` is the stable identifier for joining or filtering these records. Names and email addresses are display attributes and should not be used as durable identifiers.

The seed contains three fixed synthetic users. `stg_users` passes the four seed columns through without cleansing, deduplication, or validation, so its presence does not imply that email addresses are verified or unique.

title: Using the published users endpoint
summary: Explains the shape and intended use of the user data product published through Qry.
body_markdown:
# Using the published users endpoint

`users_model` is the curated relation published through Qry at `/users`. It returns one row per demo user with `user_id`, `full_name`, and `email`.

Use the optional `user_id` parameter for a deterministic lookup. Without that parameter, the endpoint may return the full three-row demo dataset subject to the configured response limit.

This model combines first and last name into `full_name`; it does not add behavioral, account, or activity data. A successful lookup confirms only that the synthetic record exists in the demo dataset.
